Build 1.76.01 
July 22 2024

-Bug with AutoTurretAmmo

notes.title: Playtest Update
notes.notes:
this build comes ahead of next friday's scheduled test in the discord
I am going to run various tests and figure out what breaks in MultiPlayer modes, and make fixes as fast as I can. Planning to make a bugfix push before Friday 7/26
1.76.1 asap!
Wish me luck!

Notable changes

-Cosmetic System wip, with intractable menu actor in game
-Added Molotov cocktail equipment
-damage numbers for guns, soon to be on equipment etc also..
-smaller HUD Text hints
-Weapon Damage adjustments
-Save Load System WIP, lots more to add still but you no longer lose guns while server traveling, 
-Total career kills will be saved now, along with various other stats being tracked in the near future
-Players that have a backpack equipped can now throw 2 boomerangs at one time.
-jump disabled in TS1 landers as to see if we can avoid players breaking the landers.

notes.title: Playtest Release Plan!
notes.notes:
Hello Z-Squad members!

The Playtest is live! Early Testing is exclusive to discord members only! Join our channel To get FREE keys each day in the announcement channel, and Hosting Co Op games every Friday Evening! 

[url=https://discord.gg/XW56RYQm]Discord Link[/url]

Community members are encouraged to suggest features and of course report bugs, Helpful contributors will get their steam names or offered the option to have their own custom images, painted on the walls in the actual game!

Thanks To everyone helping make Zombie Squad, Have all the Ghouls Guns n Guts it Can!
